lessons.title: Let's Make Plans!

items.exampleMeaning: Let's go to the cinema tomorrow.
On Saturday, I have a party.
We'll see each other at six.
Do you want to come to the park?

items.example: Che ne dici di andare a cena?
items.exampleMeaning: What do you think of going to dinner?
Agreed, we'll see each other at seven.

lessons.tip: Use 'domani' to talk about the next day. 'Sabato' is specific to Saturday, so remember to use it when you mean that day.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Do you want to come to the cinema tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I want to come!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What do you think of Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: On Saturday, I have a party.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Agreed, we'll see each other tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Perfect, see you tomorrow!

scenario.partnerRole: Your friend who wants to make plans.
scenario.brief: Ask if they want to go to the cinema tomorrow. Suggest Saturday as an option. Confirm the plan.
scenario.goal: You should agree on a time to meet.

lessons.title: Invitations and Responses

items.example: Ti va di andare a cena?
items.exampleMeaning: Do you feel like going to dinner?
Sounds good to me!
I'm sorry, I can't come.
Why not? Let's go together!
Maybe I can come later.
Wait a moment, I need to check.

lessons.tip: Use 'ti va di...' to invite someone to do something. If you can't go, simply say 'non posso'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ti va di andare a cena?
dialogue.meaning: Do you feel like going to dinner?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Suona bene, ma non posso stasera.
dialogue.meaning: Sounds good, but I can't tonight.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Why not?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Maybe I can come later.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Aspetta un attimo, che ore sono?
dialogue.meaning: Wait a moment, what time is it?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: It's seven o'clock.

scenario.partnerRole: Your friend inviting you to dinner.
scenario.brief: Invite your friend to dinner. Discuss their availability and suggest a different time if needed.
scenario.goal: You should find a time that works for both of you.

lessons.title: Future Plans

items.example: Il prossimo weekend andiamo al mare.
items.exampleMeaning: Next weekend, we are going to the beach.
Sometimes we go to the cinema.
We'll see each other at eight.
Yes, of course, I like it.

items.example: Mi dispiace, ho già un impegno.
items.exampleMeaning: I'm sorry, I already have an engagement.
It's fine, we'll see each other later.

lessons.tip: Use 'il prossimo weekend' to refer to the weekend that is coming up. Remember to ask 'quando?' to clarify the time.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Il prossimo weekend andiamo al mare.
dialogue.meaning: Next weekend, we are going to the beach.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: When do we meet?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: We'll see each other at eight.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, of course, I like it!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mi dispiace, ho già un impegno.
dialogue.meaning: I'm sorry, I already have an engagement.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Va bene, ci vediamo un'altra volta.
dialogue.meaning: It's fine, we'll see each other another time.

scenario.partnerRole: A friend making plans for the weekend.
scenario.brief: Talk about going to the beach next weekend. Ask when to meet and confirm the time.
scenario.goal: You should agree on a time to meet for the beach.

lessons.title: Confirming Plans

items.example: Va bene così, ci vediamo domani.
items.exampleMeaning: That's fine, we'll see each other tomorrow.

items.example: Spero di sì, di essere libero.
items.exampleMeaning: I hope so, to be free.

items.example: È un'ottima idea andare al cinema.
items.exampleMeaning: It's a great idea to go to the cinema.
Let me know if you can come.
I’m happy to hear that you are coming!
I count on it, we'll see each other tomorrow!

lessons.tip: Use 'va bene così' to confirm plans. If you are happy about something, say 'mi fa piacere'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Va bene così, ci vediamo domani!
dialogue.meaning: That's fine, we'll see each other tomorrow!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Spero di sì, di essere libero.
dialogue.meaning: I hope so, to be free.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: È un'ottima idea andare al cinema.
dialogue.meaning: It's a great idea to go to the cinema.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Let me know if you can come.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: I’m happy to hear that you are coming!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I count on it, we'll see each other tomorrow!

scenario.learnerRole: You, agreeing and confirming the details.
scenario.brief: Discuss the plans for tomorrow. Confirm the time and express your happiness about the meeting.
scenario.goal: You should confirm the plans and express your excitement.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Che ne dici di andare a cena?
dialogue.meaning: What do you think of going to dinner?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ti va di venire al parco domani?
dialogue.meaning: Do you feel like coming to the park tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Sounds good, but I can't.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Va bene, ci vediamo il prossimo weekend.
dialogue.meaning: That's fine, we'll see each other next weekend.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: When do we meet?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: We'll see each other at seven, agreed!

scenario.partnerRole: Your friend making plans for the weekend.
scenario.brief: Discuss possible plans for the weekend and confirm a meeting time.
scenario.goal: You should agree on a time to meet.
